story_text:
## A Little Book for Life's Little Questions
Coffee or tea? Go out or stay in? Sometimes, a little nudge is all you need to make a small decision—or see it from a different angle.
Think Magic 8 Ball meets the Book of Answers—in your pocket. FLIP ORACLE combines the fun of a quick YES or NO with 820 answers to spark a fresh perspective, plus 51 lucky charms for a little daily encouragement.
Think of a question, flip open the cover, and let a message surprise you on the color screen. A familiar ritual, reimaginedas a tiny electronic companion—bringing curiosity, conversation, and a little magic to everyday life.
## Little Questions. Big Reactions.
“Should I text them?” “Who’s buying coffee?”
Pass FLIP ORACLE around, take turns asking, and flip it open to reveal an answer. Laugh, debate, or ask again—the fun is seeing how everyone reacts.
820 answers. Endless conversation starters.
FLIP ORACLE = 8 Ball's instant gratification + Book of Answers' depth, in a 48×66mm pocket device. Ask for an answer, draw a lucky charm, or let YES/NO guide a small choice—a little ritual to invite mystery into your everyday life.
Sometimes, a random answer feels like a sign. But the real answer lies in how it makes you feel. Made for play and reflection, FLIP ORACLE offers a spark; your heart has the final word.
## How To Play
ASK
- Think of a question.
- Flip open the cover.
- Read your random answer.
CHARM
- Press the charm button.
- Flip open the cover.
- Reveal a random lucky symbol.
DECIDE
- Think of a YES/NO question.
- Activate decision mode.
- Press to stop. Reveal YES or NO.
## 🧐Flip Open. Find an Answer
Hold a question in mind and open the book-style cover. A digital rain animation leads into a random message on the color screen, creating a small ritual you can enjoy on your own or share with friends.
## 🍀A Little Symbol of Luck
Press the charm button to reveal a random lucky symbol. From a four-leaf clover to other playful icons, each draw brings a little surprise to your day.
## 🙆‍♀️YES or NO, in a Moment
Use the decision mode to reveal a YES/NO result with a coin-flip animation. Let it add a playful twist to small everyday choices, from what to eat to where to go.
A transparent PC shell lets you see the electronics inside. The compact book-style form combines a familiar opening gesture with a distinctive tech-inspired appearance.
## 📿Ready to Go
Carry it in your pocket or attach it to a bag with its keyring and lanyard. It is both an interactive toy and an everyday accessory.
## No App. No Internet. Just Play.
FLIP ORACLE works on its own. Open the cover or press a button to explore its modes—without pairing a phone or connecting to the internet.
## Gift a Little Wonder.
For the friend who loves unusual gadgets—or someone who seems to have everything.
With 820 answers, 51 lucky charms, and a playful YES/NO mode, FLIP ORACLE is a pocket-sized surprise they can keep exploring.
A little gift. A new everyday ritual.
## About Us
Halo Tomo is the team behind FLIP ORACLE.
We combine playful design with simple, intuitive interactions.
Our goal is to bring curiosity, surprise, and fun into everyday life.
With FLIP ORACLE, we turn a familiar ritual into a companion you can carry anywhere.
risks: Component availability, quality checks, and shipping may affect our delivery schedule. We will keep backers informed of any delays and share updates as the project progresses.

We made FLIP ORACLE for the little questions that come up every day. Flip it open to discover one of 820 answers, draw one of 51 lucky charms, or get a quick YES or NO. It’s small enough to carry in your pocket and fun to pass around when your friends can’t decide what to do next.
